content.short: Crypto Tax Calculator helps crypto investors and traders manage taxes with a flexible calculator.
content.description: Crypto Tax Calculator provides a comprehensive tax solution for crypto investors and traders across more than 20 countries, supporting 1,000+ exchanges, wallets, and protocols. The platform streamlines the tax process by automatically gathering data from exchanges, wallets, and protocols, reconciling transactions, grouping related activities, and calculating tax liabilities with precision. It concentrates on on-chain activity, including NFTs and DeFi, to deliver accurate, audit-ready reports that align with diverse regulatory contexts and help users stay compliant.
